description: Arrêts et lignes associées is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ce jeu de données liste toutes les lignes du réseau francilien et les arrêts desservis pour chacune de ces lignes comme dans le GTFS. les arrêts des lignes RER et Transilien SNCF sont des zone d'arrêts, elles sont identifiées dans le GTFS ainsi: (ID IDFM:monomodalStopPlace:XXXXXX). Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Arrêts, Lignes. Its keywords are Arrêts, Lignes, Collectivité. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL Version Française (https://doc.transport.data.gouv.fr/le-point-d-acces-national/cadre-juridique/conditions-dutilisation-des-donnees/licence-odbl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
